from AlgorithmImports import *


class IndependentSlotsAlgorithm(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1000000)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        self.a_pending = False
        self.b_pending = False

    def OnData(self, data):
        bars = {}
        for symbol in self.symbols:
            bars[symbol] = data.Bars[symbol] if data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) else None

        spy_bar = bars[self.spy]
        aapl_bar = bars[self.aapl]

        # Keep market-state quantities current whenever their own data arrives.
        if aapl_bar is not None:
            if self.previous_aapl_close is not None and aapl_bar.Close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

        current_spy_sma = None
        if spy_bar is not None and self.spy_sma.IsReady:
            current_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

        all_bars_present = all(bars[symbol] is not None for symbol in self.symbols)

        if all_bars_present:
            a_lot = int(self.Portfolio[self.spy].Quantity)
            b_lot = int(self.Portfolio[self.aapl].Quantity)

            sma_crossed_above = (
                self.spy_sma.IsReady
                and self.previous_spy_close is not None
                and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
                and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_bar.Close > current_spy_sma
            )

            sma_crossed_below = (
                self.spy_sma.IsReady
                and self.previous_spy_close is not None
                and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
                and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_bar.Close < current_spy_sma
            )

            # Evaluate all sells before any buys.
            if a_lot > 0 and not self.a_pending and sma_crossed_below:
                self.a_pending = True
                ticket = self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -a_lot, False, "A_SELL")
                if ticket.Status == OrderStatus.Invalid:
                    self.a_pending = False

            if (
                b_lot > 0
                and not self.b_pending
                and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
                and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60
            ):
                self.b_pending = True
                ticket = self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -b_lot, False, "B_SELL")
                if ticket.Status == OrderStatus.Invalid:
                    self.b_pending = False

            # Slot 1 buy.
            if a_lot == 0 and not self.a_pending and sma_crossed_above:
                quantity = int((0.40 * self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) / spy_bar.Close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.a_pending = True
                    ticket = self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity, False, "A_BUY")
                    if ticket.Status == OrderStatus.Invalid:
                        self.a_pending = False

            # Slot 2 buy.
            if (
                b_lot == 0
                and not self.b_pending
                and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
                and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
                and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20000
            ):
                quantity = int(20000 / aapl_bar.Close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.b_pending = True
                    ticket = self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity, False, "B_BUY")
                    if ticket.Status == OrderStatus.Invalid:
                        self.b_pending = False

        if spy_bar is not None:
            self.previous_spy_close = spy_bar.Close
            self.previous_spy_sma = current_spy_sma

        if aapl_bar is not None:
            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_bar.Close

    def OnOrderEvent(self, order_event):
        if order_event.Status not in [OrderStatus.Filled, OrderStatus.Canceled, OrderStatus.Invalid]:
            return

        order = self.Transactions.GetOrderById(order_event.OrderId)
        if order is None:
            return

        if order.Tag in ["A_BUY", "A_SELL"]:
            self.a_pending = False
        elif order.Tag in ["B_BUY", "B_SELL"]:
            self.b_pending = False

from AlgorithmImports import *


class IndependentDailyStrategies(QCAlgorithm):

    def Initialize(self):
        self.SetStartDate(2006, 1, 3)
        self.SetEndDate(2015, 12, 31)
        self.SetCash(1_000_000)
        self.SetWarmUp(100, Resolution.Daily)

        self.spy = self.AddEquity("SPY", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aapl = self.AddEquity("AAPL", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.ibm = self.AddEquity("IBM", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.bac = self.AddEquity("BAC", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.aig = self.AddEquity("AIG", Resolution.Daily).Symbol
        self.symbols = [self.spy, self.aapl, self.ibm, self.bac, self.aig]

        self.spy_sma = self.SMA(self.spy, 100, Resolution.Daily)
        self.aapl_rsi = self.RSI(self.aapl, 14, MovingAverageType.Wilders, Resolution.Daily)

        self.previous_spy_close = None
        self.previous_spy_sma = None
        self.previous_aapl_close = None
        self.aapl_red_streak = 0

    def OnData(self, data):
        bars = {}

        for symbol in self.symbols:
            if data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) and data.Bars[symbol] is not None:
                bars[symbol] = data.Bars[symbol]

        # Continuously maintain market-state quantities for any received bars.
        if self.aapl in bars:
            aapl_close = bars[self.aapl].Close

            if self.previous_aapl_close is None:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0
            elif aapl_close < self.previous_aapl_close:
                self.aapl_red_streak += 1
            else:
                self.aapl_red_streak = 0

            self.previous_aapl_close = aapl_close

        # If any subscribed ticker lacks today's bar, skip all rule evaluation.
        has_all_bars = len(bars) == len(self.symbols)

        if (
            has_all_bars
            and not self.IsWarmingUp
            and self.spy_sma.IsReady
            and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady
            and self.previous_spy_close is not None
            and self.previous_spy_sma is not None
        ):
            spy_close = bars[self.spy].Close
            current_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value

            # Evaluate sells before buys.
            if (
                self.Portfolio[self.spy].Quantity > 0
                and self.previous_spy_close >= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close < current_spy_sma
            ):
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.Portfolio[self.spy].Quantity)

            if (
                self.Portfolio[self.aapl].Quantity > 0
                and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60
            ):
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.Portfolio[self.aapl].Quantity)

            # Slot 1: Strategy A buy.
            if (
                self.Portfolio[self.spy].Quantity == 0
                and self.previous_spy_close <= self.previous_spy_sma
                and spy_close > current_spy_sma
            ):
                quantity = int((self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue * 0.40) / spy_close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)

            # Slot 2: Strategy B buy.
            if (
                self.Portfolio[self.aapl].Quantity == 0
                and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3
                and self.Portfolio.Cash >= 20_000
            ):
                quantity = int(20_000 / bars[self.aapl].Close)
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)

        if self.spy in bars:
            self.previous_spy_close = bars[self.spy].Close
            self.previous_spy_sma = self.spy_sma.Current.Value if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None

        all_bars_present = all(data.Bars.ContainsKey(symbol) for symbol in self.symbols)
        indicators_ready = self.spy_sma.IsReady and self.aapl_rsi.IsReady

        if all_bars_present and indicators_ready:
            spy_bar = data.Bars[self.spy]
            aapl_bar = data.Bars[self.aapl]

            spy_crosses_below = (
                prior_spy_close is not None
                and prior_spy_sma is not None
                and prior_spy_close >= prior_spy_sma
                and spy_bar.Close < self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            )

            spy_crosses_above = (
                prior_spy_close is not None
                and prior_spy_sma is not None
                and prior_spy_close <= prior_spy_sma
                and spy_bar.Close > self.spy_sma.Current.Value
            )

            # Sell phase
            if self.strategy_a_lot > 0 and spy_crosses_below:
                self.MarketOrder(self.spy, -self.strategy_a_lot)
                self.strategy_a_lot = 0

            if self.strategy_b_lot > 0 and self.aapl_rsi.Current.Value > 60:
                self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, -self.strategy_b_lot)
                self.strategy_b_lot = 0

            # Buy phase
            if self.strategy_a_lot == 0 and spy_crosses_above:
                quantity = int(math.floor(
                    float(self.Portfolio.TotalPortfolioValue) * 0.40 / float(spy_bar.Close)
                ))
                if quantity > 0:
                    self.MarketOrder(self.spy, quantity)
                    self.strategy_a_lot = quantity

            if self.strategy_b_lot == 0 and self.aapl_red_streak >= 3:
                if float(self.Portfolio.Cash) >= 20_000:
                    quantity = int(math.floor(20_000 / float(aapl_bar.Close)))
                    if quantity > 0:
                        self.MarketOrder(self.aapl, quantity)
                        self.strategy_b_lot = quantity

        if has_spy:
            self.previous_spy_close = data.Bars[self.spy].Close
            self.previous_spy_sma = (
                self.spy_sma.Current.Value if self.spy_sma.IsReady else None
            )

        if has_aapl:
            self.previous_aapl_close = data.Bars[self.aapl].Close
